{{Quote|A Sith sword is enhanced by submerging it in a trough of "blood spilled in anger." Grinding its edge with Svolten rhyolite will ensure it never dulls.|[[Sorzus Syn]]|<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Sith swords''', or '''Sith warblades''' and '''Sith daggers''', were melee weapons used by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the days of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], from [[6900 BBY]] to approximately [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Although similar to the bladed weapons utilized by the ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Sith swords were distinguished from Jedi [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|Force-imbued swords]] by their fundamental nature&mdash;both powered by and empowering the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

==Description==
[[File:SithSwordForging-BoS.png|thumb|left|180px|A Sith sword being enhanced with Sith alchemy]]
Sith swords were constructed through various metallurgical and [[Sith sorcery/Legends|arcane]] means, transmuting base metals into an [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] alloy possessing an unusual affinity for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side energies]]. The resulting rare metallic compounds used in its construction could result in blades varying in size and weight from 3 kilograms up to 6.5 kilograms. It often requires great strength of body as well as in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to successfully wield the weapon and make it as dangerous as a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. In fact, the alchemical alterations allowed the Sith sword to block incoming lightsaber attacks, as well as deflect and redirect blaster bolts in much the same way a lightsaber did.<ref name="Dark Side Sourcebook" />

A user skilled in the dark side could alter the weapon's molecular structure, making it stronger and sharper, and reverse its magnetic polarity, turning it into a high-temperature superconductor that could deflect blaster bolts and other particle weapons as if [[Magnetic seal/Legends|magnetically sealed]]. The alloy used in its construction resisted lightsabers in much the same manner as [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] and [[Phrik/Legends|Phrik]] alloy, while its polished surface reflected [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser beams]] and other coherent light weapons like a mirror. But perhaps most significantly, the weapon served as a focus for the dark energies of its wielder, amplifying their power and refining their control until they became a walking [[Vergence/Legends|nexus]] of dark side power.

==History==
The first Sith sword may have predated the earliest lightsabers.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Developed by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], Sith swords were adopted by the [[Exiles|Exiles]] following their [[Discovery of Korriban|arrival]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

[[File:Naga_Sadow_Sith_Sword.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Naga Sadow's Sith sword]]
Following the [[Funeral of Marka Ragnos|funeral]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]], [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] and [[Ludo Kressh]] used Sith swords when they dueled to succeed Ragnos.<ref name="TOTJ 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>

During the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] used [[Sith Elite Warbot]]s, a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] equipped with a Sith sword as their main weapon.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />

A pair of Sith swords was a legacy passed to [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] from his family, which could possibly trace back to [[Freedon Nadd]] himself. The pair was later passed to [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] and his cousin, [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]].<ref name="Freedon2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref>

[[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]] developed the [[Sith Tremor Sword]], used by Dark Jedi and Sith troopers alike.<ref name="kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> [[Darth Malak]] had a powerful Sith sword,<ref name="Preview 5">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/CotFPreview5|text=''Champions of the Force'' Preview 5}}</ref> although he rarely used it in combat.

During the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Dark Underlord]] wielded a pair of Sith swords.<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>

Slaver [[Phylus Mon]] provided his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Wampa/Legends|Wampa]], [[Ku-Kak]], with a Sith sword at some point before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Ku-Kak, a user of the dark side, used the sword as his weapon of choice.<ref name="AMA">{{LivingForce|A Mon Alone}}</ref>

The [[Unidentified Sith statues|statues]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] held swords resembling Sith swords.
[[File:Pic_jk.jpg|thumb|Pic owned a Sith sword in dagger size.]]
The mutated [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] and Dark Jedi [[Picaroon C. Boodle]] was skilled at using a Sith dagger,<ref name="Pod">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref> which he used to stab [[Rolanda Gron]] in the throat,<ref name="DF RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref> earning [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]'s approval.<ref name="Audio">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref> After loosing his companion [[Gorc]], Pic lunged at his killer, [[Kyle Katarn]], stabbing him with his Sith dagger.<ref name="Pod" />

Sith swords were last seen in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] when [[Tavion Axmis]], possessed by the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of Marka Ragnos, unleashed the hidden sword inside the [[Scepter of Ragnos]] against [[Jaden Korr]]. The Sith sword glowed with dark side energy as Marka Ragnos battled Jaden Korr, ending with the defeat of Marka Ragnos and the destruction of the sword and the Scepter of Ragnos.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> Any remaining examples of Sith swords in the greater [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] persist as mere historical curiosities&mdash;archaic relics of a dead civilization and their extinct culture.
